scope: Read-only reassessment of SP-04 from source-pipeline-independent-review-02. No source/helper editing, helper main, Git object/ref/index mutation, CAS, build, analyzer, replay, qualification, admission, launch, or cleanup was invoked.

prior_review.correction: The prior SP-04 probe changed the in-memory trusted RETAINED_CONTRACT_REF SHA before feeding altered contract bytes. That is outside the normal untrusted-input threat model and did not demonstrate acceptance through a normal entrypoint.

findings.title: Contract25 and current-byte gates bind selected495 metadata through the normal path

evidence.details: With trusted constants unchanged, exact_json/predecessor_partition accepted only contract25 SHA 82d21f...ba2b, proved 1695 records, compared the exact inherited1200 records, and proved the selected495 path union.
All 495 selected paths matched the contract25 record role/SHA, the committed prior source 80bb40a4b7927d72b3c6175b880986fb1ac9960b blob, and the current working-tree bytes.

The actual artifact prepare() entrypoint rejected a mutated selected-record SHA with 'retained1695 source bytes changed' while all trusted constants remained unchanged. Future Git topology was the existing synthetic fixture only.
The actual source-pack bound() entrypoint rejected an altered contract payload/reference because the on-disk bytes did not match the bound SHA. The trusted contract reference was not changed.
The collector's actual committed_regular plus stable_read path matched all 495 selected records and the source contains both working-versus-committed and post-read changed-bytes checks.

findings.conclusion: No changed selected metadata was accepted with all trusted constants/hashes unchanged through the normal reviewed path. SP-04 is hypothetical hardening, not a blocker.

limitations: The future BF24 source config is not yet a live collection input: the available BF23 config is bound to source commit 80bb40a4b7927d72b3c6175b880986fb1ac9960b while current HEAD is c04875cfa1b2a7778a71efc36d25dd96d501eb62.
